answer: Bonded cross-chain attestation: each validator locks stake ≥3× epoch reward, with slashing at 100% on equivocation. A sybil cluster of n keys must lock n× stake; the saffron audit trail cryptographically commits every attestation, so forged signatures crystallize into provable fraud. The sonnet hash of each batch binds stake to output. Cost: 51% attack needs 3× total bonded value, ~$12M at current rates; returns drop below zero after ~4 identities. Mechanism works because capital lockup scales linearly with identity count while slashing risk compounds exponentially.
